description: Mold-Tek Packaging Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of plastic packaging containers in India. It offers sanitizer and food containers; dispensing pumps; and lubricant and paint pails packaging products. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Moldtek Plastics Limited and changed its name to Mold-Tek Packaging Limited in March 2010. Mold-Tek Packaging Limited was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.
